Package org.jdesktop.swingx.plaf

package org.jdesktop.swingx.plaf
Pluggable Look and Feel (PLAF) addon infrastructure and component UI delegates (including LookAndFeelAddons).

Architectural Rationale for In-Tree Modernization: This package provides dynamic Look and Feel addon registration for custom SwingX components. It has been modernized in anahata-asi-swing to remove obsolete java.applet.Applet.class dependencies and deprecated AccessController/SecurityManager checks, providing clean classloader resolution and native theme support across FlatLaf, NetBeans, and IntelliJ IDEA environments on JDK 21-26+.
